title: fs-dir tests: static slot loading
description: Test suite static cases in test/wp11_test_backend_fs_dir.c: (1) empty directory yields zero fs-dir slots, (2) slot-0.p11k loads as slot 0, (3) slot-0.p11k + slot-3.p11k loads slots 0 and 3 with gap, (4) non-matching filename (keys.p11k, slot-.p11k) is ignored, (5) corrupted .p11k file is skipped gracefully, (6) PIN verify succeeds with correct PIN and fails with wrong PIN. Use tmpdir, independent oracles (known-good .p11k files generated by existing keystore test helpers).
